meta.engine: no-lookahead: signals from closes <= t-1, execution at t close; v1 variants (1-4) under lab/backtest.py accounting ((1+r)*(1-cost), drift between targets); v2 variants (5-7) under lab2/engine.py killswitch accounting ((1+r-cost)); V236G (8) = V236 rows + lab3/regime G1G2G3 boolean entry mask (v2 accounting); COMPOSITE_50 (9) = 50/50 V236G+mom5 drifting sub-accounts, weekly 50/50 rebalance at 5 bps/side (r_g - cost on rebalance turnover)

gate_inputs.note: ^VIX/HYG/LQD deep daily history via period1-near-listing (range=max degrades to monthly), raw closes, as-of aligned; drive the V236G/composite G1G2G3 entry mask (weekly eval on prior close)

meta.idempotency: state is fully recomputed from forward/data CSVs on every run and written atomically; re-running on the same UTC day overwrites, never appends
meta.tracker: forward OOS tracker (local simulation, virtual money)

COMPOSITE_50_V236G_mom5.description: Equal-weight composite: 50% V236G (gated V236, v2 accounting) + 50% mom_n5_k5_abs_c21 (v1 accounting) as drifting sub-accounts, rebalanced to 50/50 at the first session close of each ISO week; 5 bps/side charged on the weekly rebalance turnover (sleeve-internal costs already inside each sleeve's multipliers)

params.rebalance: weekly (first session of ISO week, at close)

COMPOSITE_50_V236G_mom5.source: lab3/adaptive (blend family) — pre-registered 2026-10-18 (forward9): static equal-weight blend of the two sleeves the 25y evidence ranks highest (adaptive_report.json table1)

V228_meanrev_vol_n1_k2_y10_sel3.description: Vol-scaled mean reversion: buy worst 1d performers when 1d return <= -2.0 * sigma20 (per-name 20d stdev of daily returns), up to 3 names at 1/3 each; exit +10% TP / -5% stop vs entry fill close

V236G_meanrev_vol_n3_k1p5_y10_sel3_G1G2G.description: V236 (worst 3d performers when 3d return <= -1.5*sigma20, up to 3 names, +10% TP / -5% stop) with entry-suppression gates G1G2G3 wired as one boolean mask by date: G1 VIX >p80(252d) latched until <p70; G2 HYG/LQD price ratio < mean60-2*sd60; G3 SPY < 200d SMA — all evaluated weekly on the PRIOR session's closes; suppressed days block NEW entries only (exits/TP/stops always run)
V236G_meanrev_vol_n3_k1p5_y10_sel3_G1G2G.source: lab3/regime (V236 + G1G2G3 stack) — pre-registered 2026-10-18 (forward9): V236 is the gauntlet's only multiple-testing survivor; the regime lab's G1G2G3 stack is its agreed risk overlay

V236_meanrev_vol_n3_k1p5_y10_sel3.description: Vol-scaled mean reversion (V236): worst 3d performers when 3d return <= -1.5 * sigma20, up to 3 names; +10% TP / -5% stop
V236_meanrev_vol_n3_k1p5_y10_sel3.source: v2 lab2 (V236) — pre-registered 2026-10-17: only variant passing White Reality Check p=0.009 + DSR 0.975 in the gauntlet; forward clock starts now (first ~3 weeks overlap its selection data — caveat recorded)

V306_killswitch_V228.description: V228 with killswitch: portfolio equity <= -10% from its running peak (forward-window peak) -> flatten to cash for 20 sessions, then resume base weights and reset the peak

base_ew12.description: Equal-weight buy-and-hold of the 12 non-benchmark names

don_p10_s8.description: Donchian: buy within 10% of 63d high, -8% stop (v1 conventions)

mom_n21_k5_abs_c1.description: XS momentum: top-5 by 21d return, abs filter (cash when n-day return <= 0), rebalance every 1d

mom_n5_k5_abs_c21.description: XS momentum: top-5 by 5d return, abs filter (cash when n-day return <= 0), rebalance every 21d
